messages: Support check failed: several claims (e.g., overview of Mclane's appeal, background issue framing, Justice Breyer relevance/burden question, Chief Justice Roberts burden/scope question) lack appropriate evidence or are not substantiated by the cited pages.
Attribution check failed: claims attribute statements to the wrong speaker (e.g., overview cites pages 16 and 38 to Allyson N. Ho, Justice Breyer question cites a Roberts question, etc.).

Overstatement check failed: the candidate overstates the content of Justice Breyer's and Chief Justice Roberts's questions, presenting them as addressing relevance and burden when the transcript shows otherwise.
Traceability is low because multiple material claims either have mismatched citations or no supporting evidence, reducing confidence in the link between claim and source.
